## History

Patty Spofford inherited her home, Patty's Place, through her brother Aaron's will. She agreed to rent the house to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) so that she and Miss [Maria](../character/maria.md) could travel to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) for three years. She stipulated that the property's name must remain Patty's Place during their tenancy.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P3](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0003), [v3 ch.Place P4](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0004), [v3 ch.Place P5](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0005), [v3 ch.Place P6](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0006), [v3 ch.Place P7](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0007), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), +64 more_

## Relationships

### [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aaron--patty.md)

Patty is the sister of [Aaron](../character/aaron.md) Spofford. As of Volume 3, their sibling relationship is established as part of her family background.

- Sibling of — sister of Aaron Spofford  <sub>[v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025)</sub>

### [Maria](../character/maria.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--patty.md)

Patty and [Maria](../character/maria.md) are close companions who live together at Patty's Place. After meeting with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), Patty agrees to rent their beloved home to the college students so that she and [Maria](../character/maria.md) can embark on a travel trip abroad to [Europe](../codex/places.md#europe) together.

- Comrade of — traveling companions abroad  <sub>[v3 ch.Confidences P8](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0008), [v3 ch.Dawn P2](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0002)</sub>
